reason: A joke sock is an impulse thing for me, and paying a fiver to maybe get it some day with no date kills the impulse. I've already got a drawer full of funny socks, so I'm not waiting in a queue for more.
objection: No delivery date at all. If the 100 reservations never come in, my €4.99 just sits there, and by the time the socks show up the duck joke has probably gone stale for me.
would_change_my_mind: Having it in stock and shipping now, or at least a firm delivery date and a refund if it never gets made. A cheaper single pair to try would also help.
